description: Fixed canary set of historical Fleet defects. Replayed k=3 via Enqueue-FleetCanary; labeled canary=true; never sole ship gate.

tasks.title: Invoke-Sol CRT argv fails on backslash-quote sequences

source.evidence: Invoke-Sol argv builder broke live on literal backslash-quote sequence (codex exit 2 unexpected argument); CRT encoder + Test-Invoke-Sol fake-launcher coverage.

tasks.prompt: Reintroduce CRT backslash-before-quote escaping failure in Invoke-Sol.ps1 ConvertTo-WindowsCommandLineArgument so a prompt containing backslash-quote truncates argv; restore with correct 2n+1 CRT encoding.

mutation.break: Remove or skip backslash doubling before embedded quotes in ConvertTo-WindowsCommandLineArgument so backslash-quote truncates the argv.

tasks.title: Object-returning Test-StructuredAudit used as bare truthiness

source.evidence: if (Test-StructuredAudit ...) is always truthy because hashtables are true; Test-FleetContract scans for bare truthiness without .valid.

tasks.prompt: Reintroduce bare truthiness use of an object-returning validator (if (Test-StructuredAudit ...) without .valid) so the contract guard fails; fix by asserting the .valid field.

mutation.break: Replace [bool]$auditCheck.valid with bare if (Test-StructuredAudit ...) / truthiness on the returned object.

tasks.title: FLEET_REQUIRED_BLOCKERS_V1 trailer must anchor at EOF

source.evidence: Sol arbitration emitted trailer with prose inside comment or JSON after closing marker; Assert-FleetRepairCoverage anchors at end-of-file and rejects both shapes.

tasks.prompt: Break Assert-FleetRepairCoverage trailer matching so non-EOF trailers pass; restore end-of-file anchor and reject trailing content after the trailer.

mutation.break: Remove the end-of-file anchor from the FLEET_REQUIRED_BLOCKERS_V1 trailer regex so mid-file trailers validate.

tasks.title: Python-to-PowerShell write collapsed backslash into empty Replace

source.evidence: heredoc collapsed backslash escapes so shipped line read empty-string Replace and threw ArgumentException; fix uses $backslash = [string][char]92.

tasks.prompt: Reintroduce empty-string Replace path normalization (or drop $backslash char-92 construction) so path normalization throws; restore $backslash = [string][char]92 and use it.

mutation.break: Replace $backslash path normalize with .Replace('','/') or empty first-arg Replace that throws on every call.

tasks.title: Handoff measure output_write phase hard deadline

source.evidence: internal defect log + Test-FleetHandoffReceipt: output_write hard deadline must fail closed with phase=output_write and bounded elapsed; locked timing numbers need feasibility estimate.

tasks.prompt: Remove or disable the hard MaxSeconds budget check during phase=output_write in Measure-FleetHandoffPerformance so a blocked write hangs; restore Assert-WithinBudget / taskkill on expiry.

mutation.break: Skip Assert-WithinBudget / WaitForExit remainingMs kill path for phase output_write so blocking writes hang past MaxSeconds.

tasks.title: Receipt/owner marker with invalid pid must not pass validation

source.evidence: internal defect log owed-review + Clear-StaleKimiK3Runtime owner markers: dead/recycled pid or missing marker must not count as live ownership; receipt validation rejects invalid typed markers.

tasks.prompt: Weaken New-FleetHandoffReceipt validation so invalid typed telemetry markers (string/bool where integer required, or contradictory lifecycle) pass; restore strict type and equality checks.

mutation.break: Coerce lifecycle_complete / context_bytes / timeout_signals via [int]/[bool] so string/bool false markers validate as success.

tasks.title: Any nonblank v-*.md counted as qualified review voice

source.evidence: Assert-FleetAdversarialReview counted any nonblank v-*.md as voice (three files with single char x + empty manifest returned verdict ok); MinVoiceBytes + content qualification required.

tasks.prompt: Lower or remove MinVoiceBytes / content qualification so a one-character v-*.md counts as a qualified voice; restore >=200 byte content checks and real review structure.

mutation.break: Set MinVoiceBytes=1 or qualify any nonblank file so single-character v-*.md voices pass STANDARD/FULL counts.

tasks.title: PowerShell -File does not splat [string[]] ArtifactFile arrays

source.evidence: powershell -File Invoke-Opus48.ps1 -ArtifactFile @(6 paths) binds only first path; callers must comma-join; Test-FleetContract guards -File call sites.

tasks.prompt: Reintroduce a raw-array ArtifactFile at a -File Invoke-Opus48/Invoke-PiGlm call site (or remove the contract guard) so only the first path binds; restore comma-joined -ArtifactFile ($paths -join ',').

mutation.break: Delete or weaken the 'ArtifactFile is comma-joined at -File call sites' case so raw $reviewArtifacts arrays are not rejected.
